description: SDEM's own standard for a complete design: what every design connects, whatever its domain. Shipped with SDEM; a profile includes it as "sdem:sdem-completeness.json". Every rule is a warning — a gap is something still to decide, never a wrong design. A planned record that does not meet a rule is 'unresolved'; an active one is 'not met'. A person may grant an exception (sdem exception grant).

standard.title: A complete design: every record connected
standard.source: ArchiMate 3.2 (which element a relationship joins); the audit of the public twin, docs/design/sdem-completeness-design.md

rules.message: a requirement is met by a process, a capability or a service
rules.reasoning: a requirement nothing realises is a requirement the design does not meet

rules.message: a process realises a capability, a value-stream stage, a service or a requirement
rules.reasoning: a process that realises nothing has no stated purpose in the design

rules.message: a business object is used by a process, an event or a service
rules.reasoning: information nothing uses is not part of the design

rules.message: a channel serves an actor or a role
an interface belongs to the component that offers it
rules.reasoning: ArchiMate: an application interface is part of an application component

rules.message: an application service is realised by a component or a function
an API operation belongs to an interface
rules.reasoning: an operation outside any interface cannot be called

rules.message: a data entity is used by a component, a function or an operation
a technology service is provided by a platform
rules.reasoning: a technology service nothing provides cannot be placed or traced

rules.message: a component has a deployment — an approved link
a data entity is stored somewhere — an approved link
rules.reasoning: data with no store cannot be traced to a platform or a zone

rules.message: an actor does something in the design, or is served by it
rules.reasoning: an actor nothing serves and who does nothing is outside the design

rules.message: an image or package belongs to a deployment or a platform, or is what a component is built as
a function is performed by a component, realises a service, or automates a process
